<style>
  :root {
    --azul-escuro: #224573;
    --azul-claro:  #4A6FA5;
    --marrom:      #6B4F4F;
    --bege:        #E5D3B3;
    --bege-claro:  #F9F5EF;
    --branco:      #FFFFFF;
  }

  /* ── Hero marrom ── */
  .apostila-hero {
    background-color: var(--marrom);
    color: var(--branco);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 2.4rem 2.2rem 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .apostila-hero h2 {
    color: var(--branco) !important;
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    border: none !important;
  }

  .apostila-hero p {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) !important;
    font-size: 1rem;
    margin: 0 0 1.4rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .apostila-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
    color: var(--branco) !important;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 3px 12px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    margin-right: 6px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* ── Botão destaque central ── */
  .btn-destaque-wrapper {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 1.6rem 0 2.2rem;
  }

  .btn-destaque {
    display: inline-block;
    background-color: var(--marrom);
    color: var(--branco) !important;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    padding: 0.8rem 2.4rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(107, 79, 79, 0.35);
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  }

  .btn-destaque:hover {
    opacity: 0.88;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  /* ── Botões secundários ── */
  .btn-group-apostila {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.7rem;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 2rem;
  }

  .btn-apostila {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.45rem;
    padding: 0.55rem 1.2rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    border: none;
  }

  .btn-apostila:hover {
    opacity: 0.88;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  .btn-outline {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--azul-escuro) !important;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--azul-escuro) !important;
  }

  /* ── Cards capítulos ── */
  .cap-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.9rem;
    margin: 1.2rem 0 2rem;
  }

  .cap-card {
    background: var(--bege-claro);
    border: 1px solid rgba(229, 211, 179, 0.7);
    border-left: 4px solid var(--azul-claro);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    color: var(--azul-escuro) !important;
    font-size: 0.87rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    display: block;
  }

  .cap-card:hover {
    background: var(--bege);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  .cap-card span {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--marrom) !important;
    margin-top: 3px;
  }

  /* ── Seção título ── */
  .secao-titulo {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--azul-escuro);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--bege);
    padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
    margin: 2rem 0 1rem;
  }

  /* ── Botões finais ── */
  .btn-group-final {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
  }

  .btn-final {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 1.8rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  }

  .btn-final:hover {
    opacity: 0.88;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  .btn-final-marrom {
    background-color: var(--marrom);
    color: var(--branco) !important;
  }

  .btn-final-azul {
    background-color: var(--azul-escuro);
    color: var(--branco) !important;
  }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .apostila-hero { padding: 1.6rem 1.2rem; }
    .apostila-hero h2 { font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .btn-group-apostila { flex-direction: column; }
    .btn-apostila { justify-content: center; }
    .btn-group-final { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
  }
</style>
